_about: Things to keep (Keepsakes, scripts/items/keepsakes.gd; README.md, Festivals): they go into the rucksack, cannot be eaten, shipped or sold, and stay as long as the farmer keeps them; held overhead they are gifts like any item (data/villagers/*.json gifts; a ribbon is neutral to everyone). keepsakes: bought ones, item id keep:<id>, {name, look {shape (chime, fan, rabbit, lantern, daruma, charm), color, accent}}; their prices are in the stall that sells them (data/festivals.json); the mizuhiki knot, a red and white cord knot, is sold at the general store (data/shops.json) and is the proposal item (data/marriage.json): held out to someone who can marry it is a proposal, not a gift. ribbons: what placing in a festival contest gives besides the prize, item id ribbon:<festival>:<place>; name is filled with the festival's name and the place's name, places by place from 1st on ({name, color}; no ribbon below the last). Every ribbon won is also noted on the board in the farmhouse (the ribbons flag; house map prop ribbon_board). Names, looks and colours are ours; the colours match the rosettes on the judges' table.
